metadata.title: Class Roster, Certification, Training, Growth, Mastery and Unlock Data
metadata.null_meaning: Unknown or not independently confirmed; not zero, false, unusable, or an impossible requirement.
metadata.skill_exp_bonus_explanation: skill_exp_bonuses means the +1/+2/etc proficiency EXP modifiers as displayed by a guide, not a complete list of usable skills or weapons.
metadata.warning: All classes covered, but not every certification grade, weapon restriction, base stat modifier, exact mastery EXP threshold, or route persistence is independently documented.
metadata.scope: The 60-player-class roster from LUM.GG; excludes enemy-only classes not included in that playable roster.
metadata.recommended_level_vs_minimum: Ideal levels are recommendations, not proven hard minimum requirements; exact minimum levels and exam pass formula are null.

route_unlocks.notes: LUM reports Bertrand 2nd mentorship unlock; RPG Site Cai Part I walkthrough does not explicitly document Troubadour unlock. Chapter unknown.
RPG Site walkthrough says 10, whereas LUM class page says 20; use 10 provisionally and preserve discrepancy.
RPG Site directly documents Dancer’s Necklace reward, LUM reports it as a Dancer class unlock. Verify equip/class association in game.
Quest starts during Chapter 10, but walkthrough states required Wonder Leaves are obtained in Chapter 11.

character_restrictions.note: Character-specific restrictions (gender, unique passives, character-only classes) remain unverified. An empty exceptions list must not be treated as proof that none exist.
